file_path.description: Path to the file to read, relative to the sandbox root.

offset.description: 1-based line number to start reading from (text files only). Default 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read (text files only). Default 2000, capped at 2000.

pages.description: PDF only: page range to read, e.g. "1-5", "3", "10-20". Max 20 pages per call. Required if the PDF has more than 10 pages.
